SELECT PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECNAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECFULLNAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECCODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.MARKET, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INSTITUTION, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUEPRICE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUBENDDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.VDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.MDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUEAMT/100000000 ISSUEAMT, CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_NAME issuerName, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECTYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECTYPE2, CASE PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUETYPE WHEN '01' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS ISSUETYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.BLNAREA, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUS, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSECBOND, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CITY_INVEST_SEC_CHB CITYINVESTSECWIND, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CCY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.FACEVALUE, CUSTOMER_INFO2.CUSTOMER_NAME WARRANTOR, PAYHSRCSECINFO.GUARTYPE, CASE
WHEN ( PAYHSRCSECINFO.CALLOPTION = 'Y' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUTOPTION = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_RIGHT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.REMARK, PAYHSRCSECINFO.COUPONSPECIES, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INTERESTRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PAPERIR, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SPREADRATE_8 SPREADRATE8, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATECODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.COEFFICIENT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.TOPRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.BOTTOMRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RESETTYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.OBSERVEBEFDAY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.OBSERVEBEFUNIT, CASE
WHEN ( PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_COUP' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUTOPTION = 'A_B_DAY' ) THEN 'A/A' ELSE PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC END AS RATEBASIC, CASE
WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_COUP' THEN '02' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_DAY' THEN '01' END AS BASISSTYLE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.WORKDAYRULE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PAYCYCLE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SCHECALRULE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.FIRSTRATEDAY FROM INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO PAYHSRCSECINFO LEFT JOIN INTERF_CUSTOMER_INFO CUSTOMER_INFO1 ON PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUERSHORT = CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN INTERF_CUSTOMER_INFO CUSTOMER_INFO2 ON CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_ID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.GUARANTOR LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECOPTION PAYHSRCSECOPTION ON PAYHSRCSECOPTION.SECID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECRATING PAYHSRCSECRATING ON PAYHSRCSECRATING.SECID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID AND PAYHSRCSECRATING.ratingtype = 'C' LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECRATING PAYHSRCSECRATING2 ON PAYHSRCSECRATING2.SECID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID AND PAYHSRCSECRATING2.ratingtype = 'I'
PAYHSRCSECINFO.VDATE <= to_date ( #{iplatformDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' )
AND PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select SECID, OPTIONSTARTDAY, OPTIONENDDAY, OPTIONPAYDAY, THEORYOPTIONPAYDAY, OPTIONPRICE, OPTIONTYPE, OPTIONCLAUSE, '01' OPTIONSTATUS from INTERF_PAYHSRCSECOPTION where SECID = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY THEORYOPTIONPAYDAY ASC

SELECT PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECNAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECFULLNAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECCODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.MARKET, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INSTITUTION, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INSTITUTIONTEXT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUEPRICE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUBENDDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.VDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.MDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.DELISTING_DATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CALLOPTION, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUTOPTION, MARKET_INFO.MARKET_AMT, MARKET_INFO.VALUE_DATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUEAMT ISSUEAMT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUERSHORT issuer, CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_NAME issuerName, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECTYPE primaryClassification, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECTYPE2 secondaryClassification, TYPE_CONFIG.INPUT_VALUE_2 SECTYPE, TYPE_CONFIG.INPUT_VALUE_3 SECTYPE2, TYPE_CONFIG.INPUT_VALUE_4 SECTYPE3, CASE PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUETYPE WHEN '01' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS ISSUETYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.BLNAREA, PAYHSRCSECINFO.FACEVALUE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUS, CASE
WHEN ( PAYHSRCSECINFO.CALLOPTION = 'Y' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUTOPTION = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ISRIGHT, 'Y' ISAUTOUPDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.IS_NETPRICE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CCY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.GUARTYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.GUARANTOR, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CITY_INVEST_SEC_WIND, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CITY_INVEST_SEC_CHB, PAYHSRCSECINFO.IS_GREEN_BOND, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSECBOND, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CROSS_MARKET_CODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.REMARK, --转债信息 PAYHSRCSECINFO.CON_FINPROD_ID, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CON_SHARE_ID, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR SHARENAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CON_VDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CON_PRICE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RESALE_PRICE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.REDEEM_PRICE, --计息要素 PAYHSRCSECINFO.COUPONSPECIES, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INTERESTRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PAPERIR, PAYHSRCSECINFO.BASE_RATE_ACCURACY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATECODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.COEFFICIENT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SPREADRATE_8 SPREADRATE8, PAYHSRCSECINFO.TOPRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.BOTTOMRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RESETTYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.OBSERVEBEFDAY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.OBSERVEBEFUNIT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.FIRST_RATE_DETERMINATION_DATE firstConfirmDate, CASE
WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/365' THEN 'A/365' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/360' THEN 'A/360' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/365F' THEN 'A/365F' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = '30/360' THEN '30/360' WHEN ( PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_COUP' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_DAY' ) THEN 'A/A' ELSE NULL END AS RATEBASIC, CASE
WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_COUP' THEN '02' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_DAY' THEN '01' ELSE NULL END AS BASICSTYLE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.FIRSTRATEDAY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SCHECALRULE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PAYCYCLE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.WORKDAYRULE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.REMARK FROM INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO PAYHSRCSECINFO LEFT JOIN INTERF_CUSTOMER_INFO CUSTOMER_INFO1 ON PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUERSHORT = CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN INTERF_CUSTOMER_INFO CUSTOMER_INFO2 ON CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_ID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.GUARANTOR LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.CON_FINPROD_ID AND PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F10' LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE_CONFIG TYPE_CONFIG on PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECTYPE = TYPE_CONFIG.OUTPUT_VALUE_1 AND (TYPE_CONFIG.OUTPUT_VALUE_2 is null or PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECTYPE2 = TYPE_CONFIG.OUTPUT_VALUE_2) AND TYPE_CONFIG.CONFIG_TYPE = 'WINDTWO_TG_TYPE' LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_MARKET_INFO MARKET_INFO ON MARKET_INFO.SEC_ID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID AND MARKET_INFO.VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{platformDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID = #{secId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} and rownum = 1

SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID secId, T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID secCode, T1.FINPROD_NAME secFullName, T1.FINPROD_ABBR secName, T1.TRADE_MARKET market, T1.REGIST_ORG institution, T1.ISSUE_PRICE, T1.IDATE pubendDate, T1.VDATE VDATE, T1.MDATE MDATE, T1.DELISTING_DATE, NVl(T1.ISSUE_AMT,0) issueAmt, T1.ISSUER, T8.CUSTOMER_NAME issuerName, T3.TYPE_9 secType, T3.TYPE_10 secType2, T3.TYPE_11 secType3, T1.ISSUE_TYPE issueType, T1.BLN_AREA blnArea, T1.IS_SUS issus, T1.IS_RIGHT isRight, T2.IS_ALLOW_OVERWRITE isAutoUpdate, T2.IS_NETPRICE isNetprice, T2.IS_NO_GUARD isNoGuard, T1.CCY CCY, T1.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE capiIncomeFeature, T2.CONCEPT_TYPE conceptType, T2.CROSS_MARKET_CODE crossMarketCode, T1.SUSTAINABLE_REMARK remark, T5.CON_FINPROD_ID conFinprodId, T6.FINPROD_ABBR conFinprodName, T5.CON_VDATE conVdate, T5.CON_PRICE conPrice, 100/T5.CON_PRICE conProportion, T5.RESALE_PRICE resalePrice, T5.REDEEM_PRICE redeemPrice, T1.COUPON_SPECIES couponSpecies, T12.CALC_TYPE interestRate, T12.YIELD YIELD, T16.BENCHMARK_ID_ACCURACY baseRateAccuracy, T16.BENCHMARK_ID rateCode, T16.COEFFICIENT coefficient, T16.SPREAD_RATE spreadRate8, T16.HIGHEST_RATE toprate, T16.LOWEST_RATE bottomrate, T16.RESET_TYPE resetType, T16.OBSERVE_BEF_DAY observeBefDay, T16.OBSERVE_BEF_UNIT observeBefUnit, T16.FIRST_CONFIRM_DATE firstConfirmDate, T12.BASIS ratebasic, T12.MARKET_BASIS marketBasis, T1.REMARK REMARK, NVL(T4.CIRCULATION_DATE,T7.LISTING_DATE) listingDate, T10.CASH_ID basisStyle, T11.CASH_ID principalCashId, T13.PAY_CYCLE payCycle, T13.PAY_TDAY_RULE workDayRule, T13.CALC_RULE calcRule, T13.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstRateDay, T2.IS_SEC_BOND isSecBond, T2.GUA_TYPE guarType, T2.ORIGINAL_OWNER originalOwner, T1.SPONSOR guarantor FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T2 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T3 ON T3.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T4.CIRCULATION_CODE = T1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T7 ON T7.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_CONVERTIBLE T5 ON T5.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T6 ON T5.CON_FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID AND T6.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{FINPROD_TYPE2_F10} LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T8 ON T8.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.ISSUER LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD T9 ON T9.CUSTOMER_ID = T8.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T10 ON T10.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T10.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FIN_CASH_BUSINESS_TYPE_01} AND T10.BRANCH = 0 AND T10.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_02} AND T10.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C02} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T11 ON T11.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T11.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FIN_CASH_BUSINESS_TYPE_01} AND T11.BRANCH = 0 AND T11.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_01} AND T11.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C01} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T12 ON T12.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T12.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F01} AND T12.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F01} AND T12.BRANCH = 0 AND T12.CASH_ID = T10.CASH_ID AND T12.IS_INITIAL = 'Y' LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE T13 ON T13.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T13.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F01} AND T13.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F01} AND T13.BRANCH = 0 AND T13.CASH_ID = T10.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO T16 ON T16.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T16.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F01} AND T16.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F01} AND T16.BRANCH = 0 AND T16.CASH_ID = T10.CASH_ID
( T1.FINPROD_ID = #{secId} OR T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{secId}) AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType} AND T1.TRADE_MARKET IN (#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02},#{TRADE_PLACE_03},#{TRADE_PLACE_04})

SELECT SECID id, SECNAME text, SECNAME object, SECID parentId FROM INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO
and (SECID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or SECNAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or SECFULLNAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') )

SELECT VDATE intereststartday, MDATE interestendday, PAY_DATE interestpayday, RANGE_YIELD couponrate, INT_PRIN_AMT prinamt, INT_AMT accrueintamt, BASIS basis, PRIN_AMT prinAmt, CASH_AMT cashAmt from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp WHERE fcp.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F01} AND fcp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F01} AND fcp.BRANCH = 0 AND fcp.CASH_ID = #{cashId}

SELECT EXERCISE_STATUS optionStatus, VDATE optionStartDay, MDATE optionEndDay, EXERCISE_TYPE optionType, EXERCISE_DATE theOryOptionPayDay, ACT_EXERCISE_DATE optionPayDay, EXERCISE_PRICE optionPrice, EXERCISE_REMARK optionClause from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN fep WHERE fep.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F01} AND fep.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F01} AND fep.BRANCH = 0 AND fep.CASH_ID = #{cashId}
